name: Default No-Blades Support
dsl: ?(deck.remaining >= 2) potent @ spell(any<trap>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) | ?(self.health < 30%) any<heal> @ self | ?(ally(last).health < 30% && ally(last).is_dead == 0) any<heal> @ ally(last) | ?(ally(last).is_dead == 1) any<damage & aoe>[any<mod_damage>] | ?(ally(last).is_dead == 1) any<damage>[any<mod_damage>] @ enemy | "Feint Mass - Amulet" | any<trap & !aoe & stacks>[potent] @ boss | any<trap & aoe & stacks> | any<trap & !aoe>[potent] @ boss | any<trap & aoe> | any<global> | pass
description: Support for a boss that cheats when a Blade is cast; it never casts or enchants one. Below 30% health it heals itself, then P1. Otherwise Mass Feint, Feint and traps on the boss, each that stacks before the same ones that don't, then a global, and it passes rather than spend P1's buffs. Once P1 is dead, it attacks.
